content: Ga wa tengogne netyalu satu getkaluru, tsrupotu koglajrewatachri. Payokgipre Goyakalutowrene payokgipre ralipre tsru salewakchikaka waneyalune. Gi rixanu tyekakaya ralipreta Goyakalu gimtuwnale.

Ga wa netlu tsru wenu witryoga pixkalutu xirnachrimero yapjetachri. Ga wa kmatsuru gaalixachine, ga wa yaglu, ga wa giwakpejnu gaalixachine, witryo pixkalutu tsru wenu gogomta tunwatachine. Ga wa gitlopitskaka Goyakalunu waneyalune.
Ga wa shikaletluna Goyakalu wayegreru Moysisi shikale ga wa gowega Wgene shikale. Wane china shikaletna:

content.text: Potuko potu ga wa galikakpotunanu pixjetyawaka.

content: Wanepnute neta. Ga wa kotpuukalurni kpashiwakpotugruko, gipgujtatikowakapji gajerugruko tengogne gajeru.
Ga wa kpashiwakpotugruko rushpakyana payokgipre Goyakalutowrene, payokgipre tsru salewakchikaka waneyalune. Katajimtalu powralu mkachrichrata gitakachine. Ga wa gishrikakjeputachine korimtaya.
Ga wa satu wa gepkoxamkoje giwekachine genekna payokgipre Goyakalutowrene payokgipre koriproswaga katseplu rumtuwnale giwekgognenatachri gike rixiniko mnikawnakatu Goyakalu.

Ga wa kpashiwakpotugruko katseplu kapgyalu Goyakalu goyaknu chinanu ga wa ruyakle chinanu. Ga wa gike gimkata jiglokletlu kpashiwakpotugruko nikawninpotunanuko payokgipre tsru salewakchikaka payokgipre Goyakalutowrerunenu.
